candidates.what_happened: At the 80th UN General Assembly, an escalator carrying Trump and Melania stopped mid-ride and his teleprompter went dark; Trump demanded a 'triple sabotage' investigation. In the speech itself he told world leaders 'your countries are going to hell' over immigration and climate policy, called wind power 'a joke,' and claimed he had 'ended seven unendable wars.'

quotes.speaker: Donald Trump

candidates.what_happened: Trump posted that he was authorizing troops to protect 'War ravaged Portland' and ICE facilities from 'Antifa, and other domestic terrorists,' ordering up to 200 National Guard members with 'Full Force, if necessary.' Portland's mayor and Oregon's governor called the description flatly false and said zero troops were needed; the state sued and a federal judge blocked the deployment.

candidates.what_happened: Trump repeated at the UN and elsewhere that he 'ended seven wars' and deserves the Nobel Peace Prize; only 22% of Americans agreed in polling, and the prize ultimately went to Maria Corina Machado.

quotes.text: No president or prime minister has ever done anything close to that.

candidates.reason: The 'seven wars' Nobel claim is the same UN General Assembly speech already covered in the picked un_meltdown story, and the same underlying bit ('I solved wars') was already the topic of episode 2025-08's n3_six_wars story. Cut as a duplicate topic both within this episode and against the prior episode.

candidates.what_happened: The House Oversight Committee released files including an alleged Trump birthday note to Jeffrey Epstein with lines like 'a pal is a wonderful thing... may every day be another wonderful secret.'
candidates.reason: No video of a 'moment' exists -- it's a leaked paper document, and Trump denies writing it, so there's no on-camera Trump event to build a beat around. candidates.what_happened: After conservative activist Charlie Kirk was assassinated on September 10, Trump ordered flags lowered and gave remarks blaming 'the radical left.'
candidates.reason: A real assassination is not comedic/absurd material for a 'dumbest moments' countdown regardless of footage availability -- cut on tone grounds, not video availability.
